newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cuts import tariffs 10 to 25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cuts import tariffs 10 to 25 percent.

text.p: Egypt gave details on Wednesday of across-the-board import tariff cuts of between 10 and 25 percent.
A presidential decree published in government newspapers confirmed that the maximum rate for goods other than luxuries has fallen to 55 percent from 70 percent.

The decree also detailed new reduced tariff rates for specific categories of goods, mainly raw materials for the plastics, metals and textile industries.
The rate for ethylene, for example, falls to five percent. The old tariff was not immediately available.
The tariff cuts are the last important measures which should be in place if the board of the International Monetary Fund is to endorse a draft agreement with Egypt on October 11.
Board endorsement is expected to clear the way for Egypt's Paris Club creditors to waive $4 billion in official debt.
